tweetText: SAP highlights that enterprise AI governance boosts profit margins by ensuring accurate data control over unreliable consumer models. This approach enhances decision-making and reduces errors, crucial for business success. via AI News

GitHub Copilot will switch to a per-token charging model starting June 1, 2026, replacing its flat subscription rate. This change could impact how developers budget for AI tools and manage usage. via AI News.
Meta has acquired robotics startup Assured Robot Intelligence to enhance its humanoid AI capabilities. This move shows Meta's commitment to advancing AI technology in robotics. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk testified for three days in his lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming the shift to a for-profit model betrayed its nonprofit roots. This case raises important questions about the ethics of AI development and funding. via TechCrunch AI

The Pentagon has signed deals with Nvidia, Microsoft, and AWS to integrate AI into classified networks. This move aims to diversify its AI partnerships following a fallout with Anthropic over usage terms. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk took the stand in his lawsuit against OpenAI, revealing messy details about the company's shift to a for-profit model. This case could reshape the future of AI governance and accountability. via TechCrunch AI
A nonprofit backed by OpenAI executives is funding influencers to promote fears about Chinese AI as a threat. This campaign could shape public perception and policy on AI technology. via WIRED AI

The Musk v. Altman trial is revealing key evidence, including emails and documents from OpenAI's early days. This matters because it sheds light on the founding dynamics and influences shaping the future of AI. via The Verge AI

The Pentagon has secured AI deals with major tech companies like OpenAI, Google, and Nvidia but excluded Anthropic due to supply-chain concerns. This move boosts the military's access to advanced AI tools for classified operations. via The Verge AI.

Elon Musk struggled in court this week while pushing a claim that OpenAI "stole a nonprofit." His courtroom performance raises questions about his credibility as he battles a case many believe he won't win. via The Verge AI
